props.title: Sync across devices and edit with your team
props.lead: Connect a project to a ShowAI server to sync it across devices and invite collaborators. Use the official ShowAI Cloud or host your own server; both use the same protocol and settings interface.

content.text: Management sharing: Each project has its own members and roles, and accounts and device tokens belong to their respective servers. Each device retains a complete copy in the local content library. The saving is completed locally and then published to the server in the background.
The server is only responsible for storing, verifying and distributing content.
Do not execute uploaded component code
. Click on the nodes in the diagram to view each party's responsibilities.

props.caption: Three parties in a shared project: your device, the server, and other members’ devices

nodes.label: Workbench
nodes.detail: The save is written to the local content library first, without waiting for the network. Running workbenches are automatically synchronized in the background.

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.detail: When the content library is shared with the workbench, synchronization is coordinated by project. The independently running Agent can perform `showai sync run `immediate synchronization after writing; successful local saving does not mean that it has been published to the server.

nodes.label: server
nodes.detail: Save accounts, device sessions, project members, and the current status of each project. Before publishing, verify object and component dependencies, and then update the project head according to conditions; conflicts will be returned when someone publishes first.

nodes.label: Editor
nodes.detail: Receive change notifications in real time via WebSocket; small modifications are delivered directly with notifications, and large modifications are downloaded via HTTP.

nodes.label: Viewer
nodes.detail: The current content can be read and downloaded, but modifications cannot be submitted.

content.text: All operations are in "Settings → Server and Sync". It is divided into three parts: "Project Synchronization" lists the synchronization status of each project on this machine, "Server Account" manages logins and devices, and "Account Binding" connects accounts on different servers.

steps.title: Add server account
steps.body: Click "Add Server Account" in "Server Account", fill in the server address, and then select "Log in to an existing account", "Register a new account" or "Use Token". The address is the server base address, **excluding `/api `**. Registering a new account requires a registration key provided by the server administrator; if there is no key, ask the project administrator for an invitation link.

steps.title: Upload an existing project
steps.body: Expand the project in "Project Synchronization", click "Upload to Server", select the account and click "Upload and start synchronization". You can also set "Save new projects to by default" as this account, and new projects will be automatically uploaded in the future.
steps.result: This project is created on the server, you become the administrator, and the local content is retained.

steps.title: Invite members
steps.body: Open the "Members and Invitations" of the project, select the permissions after joining and the number of accounts to receive in "Invite Members" (or specify a registered account), click "Generate Invitation Link", and then "Copy the Link" to send it to the other party.

steps.title: The other party joins
steps.body: The other party opens the `showai://join `link on the invitation page, or pastes the link in "Project Synchronization → Join Shared Project", confirms the server, project and role and clicks "Confirm to join the project". If you do not have an account for this server, you can register directly on the invitation card. **Registration through invitation does not require a registration key**.
steps.result: It prompts "The project has been joined and the current project content is being downloaded."

showai sync connect --url https://showai.renaissancemind.ai/cloud --account ACCOUNT --password-file PRIVATE_FILE --json

showai sync run --project PROJECT --json                        # 立即同步
showai sync status --json                                       # 查看状态、错误和 remoteHead

The server checks the session and current membership on every access. There are no global roles such as server administrator or owner: every logged in user can create his own project and become its administrator.

props.note: The project always retains at least one administrator: **The last administrator cannot quit or demote**, and another member needs to be set as an administrator first.

content.text: The invitation is valid for 7 days by default and can be received by a maximum of 25 accounts; it can be changed to a single time, other maximum number of people, unlimited number of people, or only a certain registered account is allowed.
Repeated confirmation of the same account will not occupy the quota again, nor will it change the assigned permissions.
After a member is removed, the other party can no longer access the server content, nor can he rejoin using the used link; however,
The copy that has been downloaded to the other party's device is still in the other party's possession.
. When moving out, valid invitations created or received by the member will be revoked by default.

props.title: How does a modification reach other members?

steps.label: Save locally
steps.detail: The content is first written to the local content library, and then synchronized immediately. Multiple edits during the disconnection period will be merged into one upload.

steps.label: Upload missing objects
steps.detail: Only the changed parts are transmitted; the same content is reused as a summary. Objects above 5 MiB use resumable upload tasks, which can be uploaded after disconnection or server restart.

steps.label: Publish under baseline conditions
steps.detail: Publish with the baseline token from the last sync. The server updates the project head after verifying object and component dependencies.

steps.label: new head
steps.detail: If someone publishes first during the period, a conflict will be returned here: your device downloads the other party's version, merges it, and then publishes it.

steps.label: Push change notifications
steps.detail: Connected devices receive notifications via WebSocket. When the real-time connection is unavailable, it will be filled in by the next scheduled check.

steps.label: Merge and write to native
steps.detail: Save the complete merge recovery draft first, and then write the current content. When exiting halfway, merge and publish from the recovery draft next time.

To add or remove a login method and generate a personal token, you need to have directly logged in to this server in the last 15 minutes.

After binding the accounts on different servers in "Account Binding", the new device only needs to log in to one of them, and the login to other servers can be restored at the same time. Each server issues its own device session, and the original token is not copied between servers. Binding means that these servers can issue access authorizations to each other for accounts in the group.

steps.title: Select run mode and start
steps.body: The data directory should only be read and written by the service process. When `SHOWAI_SERVER_HOME `is not set, the data is written in `showai-server-data `in the current directory.

variants.label: Docker Compose
variants.code:
# 读取当前 shell 中的 SHOWAI_* 变量；数据挂载到 deployments/server/data
# 该目录需允许容器内 UID 1000 写入
docker compose -f deployments/server/compose.yml up -d

variants.label: systemd (user level)
variants.code:
# 示例安装目录 ~/services/showai-project-server：
#   dist-server/、runtime/（独立的 Node.js）、server.env（权限 0600）
mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user
cp deployments/server/showai-project-sync.service ~/.config/systemd/user/
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now showai-project-sync

steps.title: Configure external address
steps.body: By default, only `127.0.0.1:8788 `is monitored. Set `SHOWAI_SERVER_URL `when serving external services, which can bring sub-paths (such as `https://example.com/cloud `), **excluding `/api `**; the reverse proxy needs to forward the entire prefix as it is, and the invitation link also uses this address.
steps.note: When not set, the invitation uses the server address at the time of request, and external members may not be able to access it.

steps.title: Register your first account
steps.body: Select "Register a new account" in the App's "Add Server Account" and fill in the registration key, then upload the project and invite members. Subsequent members can register by invitation.
steps.note: The server defaults to controlled registration; the Linux version can set `SHOWAI_REGISTRATION_MODE=open `open registration.
